# Vendored mbedtls-3.6.7

Source: [mbedtls source archive](https://github.com/Mbed-TLS/mbedtls/releases/download/mbedtls-3.6.7/mbedtls-3.6.7.tar.bz2)

Archive SHA-256: `a7e8bcbec0e6f761b4af24f25677626b35f762f68eef79c08677a363212d11f6`.

This directory contains the unmodified files needed by the embedded OpenVPN build,
with their upstream license files. No system VPN drivers or standalone clients
are built. OpenVPN source is used under MPL-2.0; Mbed TLS under Apache-2.0.

`SOURCE-FILES.sha256` records the included upstream files.
